'''''Phalaenopsis'' subg. ''Hygrochilus''''' is a [[subgenus]] of the [[genus]] ''[[Phalaenopsis]]''.<ref name = "Kocyan & Schuiteman, 2014" /><ref name = "Li et al., 2016" />

==Description==
[[File:Sedirea subparishi - cropped.jpg|thumb|right|''Phalaenopsis subparishii'' flower]]
[[File:The Orchid Album-02-0042-0061-Vanda parishii marriottiana.png|thumb|right|Illustration of ''Phalaenopsis marriottiana'']]
===Vegetative characteristics===
The species are epiphytic, monopodial herbs.<ref name = "Li et al., 2014" />
===Generative characteristics===
The labellum is spurred.<ref name = "Li et al., 2014" /> The flowers have four pollinia.<ref name = "Li et al., 2014">Li, M. H., Zhang, G. Q., Liu, Z. J., & Lan, S. R. (2014). [https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Zhong-Jian-Liu/publication/260210955_p_classHeadingRunIn_Revision_of_Hyg_rochilus_Orchidaceae_Epidendroideae_Aeridinae_and_a_molecular_phylogenetic_analysis_p/links/5ff4ff91a6fdccdcb8339e96/p-classHeadingRunIn-Revision-of-Hyg-rochilus-Orchidaceae-Epidendroideae-Aeridinae-and-a-molecular-phylogenetic-analysis-p.pdf Revision of ''Hygrochilus'' (Orchidaceae: Epidendroideae: Aeridinae) and a molecular phylogenetic analysis.] Phytotaxa, 159(4), 256-268.</ref>

==Taxonomy==
===Publication===
It was first published as ''Hygrochilus'' {{small|Pfitzer}} by [[Ernst Hugo Heinrich Pfitzer]] in 1897<ref name = "IPNI a">''Hygrochilus'' Pfitzer. (n.d.). International Plant Names Index. Retrieved November 30, 2024, from https://www.ipni.org/n/29720-1</ref> with ''Hygrochilus parishii'' {{small|(Rchb. f.) Pfitzer.}} as the type species.<ref name = "Tropicos">Missouri Botanical Garden. (n.d.-b). ''Hygrochilus'' Pfitzer. Tropicos. Retrieved November 30, 2024, from https://legacy.tropicos.org/Name/40029174</ref> It was later integrated into the genus ''Phalaenopsis'' {{small|Blume}} on the subgeneric level as ''Phalaenopsis'' subg. ''Hygrochilus'' {{small|(Pfitzer) Kocyan & Schuit.}} published by [[Alexander Kocyan]] and [[André Schuiteman]] in 2014.<ref name = "IPNI b">''Phalaenopsis'' subgen. ''Hygrochilus'' (Pfitzer) Kocyan & Schuit. (n.d.). International Plant Names Index. Retrieved November 30, 2024, from https://www.ipni.org/n/77138161-1</ref><ref name = "Kocyan & Schuiteman, 2014">Kocyan, A., & Schuiteman, A. (2014). [https://www.biotaxa.org/Phytotaxa/article/view/phytotaxa.161.1.3 New combinations in Aeridinae (Orchidaceae).] Phytotaxa, 161(1), 61-85.</ref>
===Species===
It consists of the following species:
{{Div col}}
*''[[Phalaenopsis hygrochila]]'' J.M.H.Shaw
*''[[Phalaenopsis japonica]]'' (Rchb.f.) Kocyan & Schuit.<ref name = "Schuiteman, 2014">Schuiteman, A. (2014) [https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Andre-Schuiteman/publication/364331800_Phalaenopsis_the_limits_of_a_genus/links/6349d2962752e45ef6b7d4e0/Phalaenopsis-the-limits-of-a-genus.pdf ''Phalaenopsis'': the limits of a genus.]</ref>
*''[[Phalaenopsis marriottiana]]'' (Rchb.f.) Kocyan & Schuit.<ref name = "Schuiteman, 2014" />
*''[[Phalaenopsis subparishii]]'' (Z.H.Tsi) Kocyan & Schuit.<ref name = "Schuiteman, 2014" />
*''[[Phalaenopsis tsii]]'' (M.H.Li, Z.J.Liu & S.R.Lan) Hua Deng, Z.J.Liu & Yan Wang<ref name = "Li et al., 2016">Li, M. H., Gruss, O., & Liu, Z. J. (2016). [https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Zhong-Jian-Liu/publication/308161582_Nomenclature_changes_in_Phalaenopsis_subgen_Hygrochilus_Orchidaceae_Epidendroideae_Vandeae_based_on_DNA_evidence/links/60e2696092851ca944a9ec9e/Nomenclature-changes-in-Phalaenopsis-subgen-Hygrochilus-Orchidaceae-Epidendroideae-Vandeae-based-on-DNA-evidence.pdf Nomenclature changes in ''Phalaenopsis'' subgen. ''Hygrochilus'' (Orchidaceae; Epidendroideae; Vandeae) based on DNA evidence.] Phytotaxa, 275(1), 55-61.</ref>
{{Div col end}}
